rules: plain expression or IIFE;no imports;no comments;ends with copy(...)

rules: the courier contract in courier/README.md: reads and returns, never navigates or writes;no comments

rules: a prompt, not code;self-contained: the goal, the steps, and the report's exact shape;names no agent product;changes nothing in any repo;the report is the whole output
gloss: Hand the prompt to a computer-use agent on the home laptop (Claude Dispatch, Gemini in Antigravity, or Codex) and paste its report onto the errand; if no agent can do it, do it yourself.

rules: a script in mehrlander/web-tools run by .github/workflows/errand-browser.yml;reads only what the job's own read-only token reaches;prints one RESULT {json} line;exits nonzero on failure
gloss: Nothing for you to do: the session dispatches the workflow on a GitHub-hosted runner and reads the result from its log.

rules: a link to pages/scratch/toss-top-probe.html with probe=<errand id> and steps=;the page drives every step itself;closes the errand by writing errands/results/<id>.json with the device's stored token;a banner says when it is done
gloss: Open the link on your iPhone and leave it until the banner turns green or red; the page files the result itself.
